items.title: Meta’s Muse shopping agent launches in the UK
summary: On 24 November, Retail Gazette reported that Meta had launched its Muse shopping assistant in the UK with retailers including JD Sports and ASOS.
The publication said the assistant can compare products and create baskets, while purchases require the customer’s approval.
items.why: Retailers may need accurate product and stock data when customers discover products through AI assistants.

items.title: Adobe reports $9.7 billion in US Black Friday online spending by early evening
summary: Reuters reported that Adobe Analytics measured $9.7 billion in US online spending by 6:30 p.m. Eastern Time on 27 November, up 12.8% from the same point a year earlier.
Adobe projected a final total of $13 billion to $13.4 billion; this was a forecast, not a completed sales figure.
items.why: Intraday demand estimates help retailers assess checkout capacity and fulfilment needs during major promotions.

language.example: We shared an intraday estimate of order volume.
